description: This file contains shell script utilities for crash upload management, including functions to retrieve system information such as MAC address, IP address, SHA1 checksum, and system uptime, as well as configuration handling based on device and box types.

methods.name: getLastModifiedTimeOfFile
methods.description: Returns the last modified timestamp of a specified file.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in a specific format.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device, varying based on device type and box type.

methods.name: getSHA1
methods.description: Calculates and returns the SHA1 checksum of a given file.

methods.name: getIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the device, with special handling for specific box types and IPv6 status.

methods.name: processCheck
methods.description: Checks if a process is running based on its name.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address associated with the CM interface.

methods.name: getErouterMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the erouter interface, with device-specific logic.

methods.name: rebootFunc
methods.description: Reboots the system with optional process and reason parameters.

methods.name: Uptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model number of the device from version file.
